component.name: Gnome AI Chat
component.summary: Chat with local AI models via Ollama

description.p: Gnome AI Chat is a simple, modern chat interface built specifically for the GNOME desktop. It communicates with your local Ollama HTTP API to interact with large language models completely offline and privately.

ul.li: Native GNOME experience with GTK4 and Libadwaita.
Automatic detection of local models and in-app model pulling.
Real-time streaming and deep reasoning capabilities.
Custom @ personas/skills for specific tasks with a dedicated markdown editor.
Agentic capabilities via system tools for web fetching, file searching, code execution, and desktop automation.
Semantic vector search across past conversations.
Multimodal capabilities with image and text file attachments.
Interactive HTML Canvas for rendering UIs natively.
Smart chat organization with AI-generated titles and emojis.
Local RAG to chat with your local files and documentation via a private vector store.
Rich text rendering with native Markdown tables and code blocks.
Slash commands for powerful inline actions.
Detailed resource monitoring and performance analytics.
Privacy-first 100% local SQLite database.

description.p: This release adds Model Context Protocol servers and keeps long conversations within the model's context window.

ul.li: Added an MCP Servers window to register stdio and Streamable HTTP servers whose tools are offered to the model, with a dedicated permission category and per-server overrides.
Added the /mcp command to manage and reload servers, with automatic reconnection when a server drops.
Requests now fit the context window: the oldest messages are left out first and long tool results are shortened, while the system prompt and current message are always kept.
Tool calls are limited to 10 rounds per response and run one at a time when they need permission or change something.
A warning now appears when the selected model does not support tools or images in use.

description.p: This release restores model update notifications and makes skill activation more visible and reliable.

ul.li: Fixed the model update banner never appearing because the Ollama registry changed its digest header.
Fixed the model list not refreshing after pulling a model while the app was already running; newly pulled models are now selected automatically.
Added an active skill indicator in the input toolbar and validation of skill names in the Skills editor.
Fixed skill mentions being ignored when files were attached and prefix collisions between similarly named skills.

description.p: This release strengthens control over model tool usage with a richer permission system and fixes reasoning levels for gpt-oss models.

ul.li: Added a Deny tier to tool permissions alongside Ask and Auto-accept; denied tools are hidden from the model entirely.
Added new File Reads and Applications permission categories covering file reading, directory listing, file search, and app launching.
Fixed reasoning levels (low/medium/high) being ignored for tagged gpt-oss model ids.
Improved chat responsiveness by caching model capability lookups instead of fetching them on every turn.

description.p: This release introduces a native GNOME Shell extension for seamless desktop integration.

ul.li: Added a native GNOME Shell extension written in TypeScript supporting GNOME Shell 45 through 51.
Integrated a status indicator in the top panel and a global keyboard shortcut (default Super+i) to toggle the chat window.
Added new npm integration scripts for building, installing, and enabling the extension locally.
Incorporate GNOME Shell extension coding conventions and ambient type definitions.

description.p: This release adds support for D-Bus activation, allowing notification clicks to launch/open the app when closed.

ul.li: Added D-Bus activation support to desktop launcher and Flatpak configuration.
Refactored application startup lifecycle to handle action activation cleanly on a cold start.

description.p: This release fixes a critical database initialization race condition at startup.

ul.li: Deferred loading of performance stats until after database migrations are fully complete, preventing the no-such-table error.

description.p: This release updates Flatpak packaging for Flathub compliance, resolves desktop validation issues, and improves AppStream metadata standards.

ul.li: Adapted Flatpak manifest and generated offline npm cache registry sources for sandboxed builds.
Replaced deprecated AppStream developer tags with the modern developer name and ID format.
Fixed desktop launcher entry category and specification version validation warnings.

description.p: This release optimizes code block rendering, enhances multimodal workflows with automatic tool attachments, and streamlines desktop integration.

ul.li: Optimized code block rendering during streaming to eliminate flickering.
Implemented automatic tool attachments for seamless multimodal sequences.
Added right-click context menu to images for quick downloading.
Streamlined desktop integration by removing autonomous agent control while preserving manual screenshot and app-launching tools.
Improved developer experience with global console types and stable file promisification.

description.p: This release introduces a new Regenerate Response action, RSS feed tools, and major enhancements to slash commands and file attachments.

ul.li: Added "Regenerate response" action on user messages to easily re-submit prompts.
Added RSS Feed Tool to natively parse RSS/Atom feeds for AI processing.
Enhanced Slash Commands with better argument parsing safety and dynamic feedback.
Upgraded Hacker News command (/hn) with specialized best, newest, and custom search subcommands.
Enhanced File Attachments with /files attach (fuzzy search) and /files search (semantic vector search).
Disabled smart summarization for empty conversations to prevent unnecessary API calls.

description.p: This release fixes critical bugs and includes stability improvements.

ul.li: Fixed critical race conditions on startup preventing data loss on rapid actions.
Optimized semantic file search performance and increased result limits.

description.p: This release brings native Markdown tables, command visibility controls, unit tests, and significant performance optimizations.

ul.li: Implemented a robust markdown table parser that natively renders tables using Gtk.ColumnView.
Added visibility controls for slash commands to hide internal actions.
Improved database performance by wrapping bulk insert operations in SQLite atomic transactions.
Implemented automatic background vector indexing for conversations and skills.
Added robust, mock-free unit tests for pure logic modules.
Updated all skill prompts with detailed tool usage instructions and strategies for maximum agent orientation.
Refined Writer, Reviewer, and Automation skills to ensure proper tool usage and focus.

description.p: This release introduces a robust SQLite database migration and semantic skill discovery.

ul.li: Migrated data storage from legacy JSON files to a robust SQLite database with fully asynchronous operations.
Implemented semantic matching for skills using local text embeddings.
Auto-attach screenshots directly to the chat input for visual analysis.
Optimized Ollama client for consistent persona application during complex tool-call sequences.
Improved code block parsing strategy with support for nested blocks.

description.p: This release brings Local RAG capabilities and Tool Execution Permissions.

ul.li: Added Local RAG to chat with local folders via a private SQLite vector store using the @files skill.
Added Tool Execution Permissions security layer for shell commands and file writes.
New UI to manage, remove, and re-index local project paths for the vector store.
Moved desktop automation to native Wayland portals.

description.p: This release focuses on syntax highlighting fixes.

ul.li: Fixed code block syntax highlighting when reusing widgets during content streaming.

description.p: This release brings a dedicated Skills Editor window and skill management enhancements.

ul.li: Added dedicated Skills Editor window with GtkSource markdown editor.
Skills are grouped into Builtins and Custom sections with sidebar search.
Added /skills slash command and Keyboard Shortcut (Ctrl+E).
Auto-trigger Memory skill for /memory sub-commands.
Fixed out-of-bounds array access in image previewer.
Wrapped skill dialog system prompt for consistent styling.

description.p: This release brings image preview functionality, UI enhancements, and model capability awareness.

ul.li: Added full-size Image Preview and Slideshow.
Added Skill Prompt Syntax Highlighting.
Added Model Update Notifications and Dynamic Model Capabilities tracking.
Vision-aware attachments and tool-required model selection to prevent invalid actions.

description.p: Major feature release bringing numerous enhancements to chat, attachments, and application functionality.

ul.li: Added Auto-Summarize conversation titles in the background.
Added text file attachments and interactive HTML Canvas rendering.
Added Model Pull Dialog with real-time progress.
Added robust slash commands including /hn, /memory, /compress, and /debug.
